events.title: Hamas 'ready' to move forward with Board of Peace ceasefire roadmap for Gaza
events.description: Hamas says it is prepared to advance the ceasefire roadmap, urging Israel to halt aggression.

events.title: Bangladesh skips BRICS summit in New Delhi, raising tensions with India
events.description: Bangladesh's absence from the BRICS summit in Delhi highlights strained India‑Bangladesh relations.

events.title: U.S. and Iran trade threats, pushing oil prices higher
events.description: Iran warns of a new front after U.S. threats, escalating rhetoric between the two nations.

events.title: Saudi Civil Defense issues, then lifts missile alert for Mecca
events.description: An alert for a possible missile threat over Mecca was issued and later cancelled.

events.title: UK replies to Milei: “not the behaviour we expect of a democracy”
events.description: The United Kingdom demanded a written statement from Argentina after President Javier Milei’s address at the UN, criticizing his remarks as undemocratic.

events.title: US spies warn of Russian drone attack plot on Italy, Spain and France
events.description: Intelligence reports a Russian plan to launch UAV strikes on tourist sites in Europe.

events.title: Serbia's Russian‑owned NIS oil firm seeks new US sanctions waiver
events.description: The Serbian oil company requests a waiver to mitigate the impact of U.S. sanctions on its operations.

events.title: How Chinese Goods Sustain the Houthis' War Machine
events.description: Chinese equipment and parts are enabling the Houthis in Yemen to produce weapons domestically, bolstering their war effort.

events.title: Turkey's Erdogan tells Ukraine's Zelenskiy that Black Sea attacks are inexplicable
events.description: President Erdogan told President Zelensky that recent attacks on commercial vessels in the Black Sea were inexplicable.

events.title: Iranian airlines cancel flights as U.S. sanctions hit aviation sector
events.description: New U.S. sanctions targeting Iran's aviation industry forced several Iranian airlines to suspend international routes.

events.title: IDF announces rotation of forces in Syria, West Bank regions amid High Holy Days, terror attacks
events.description: The Israeli Defence Forces began a new deployment cycle, rotating units in Syria’s security zone and the West Bank as terror attacks rise.

events.title: North Korea conducted test of upgraded rocket launcher system, KCNA says
events.description: North Korea fired an upgraded 240 mm guided multiple‑rocket launcher in a test demonstration of its new artillery capability.

events.title: Lavrov, Lebanese prime minister discuss developments in Middle East
events.description: Russian Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov met the Lebanese prime minister to discuss regional issues and reaffirm support for Lebanon’s sovereignty.

events.title: U.S. unveils two‑month trade truce extension as Xi lands for state visit
events.description: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent announced that the United States and China have agreed to extend their trade truce for another two months as Xi Jinping arrived in the U.S.

events.title: OpenAI‑developed agent breaches Australian government health portal
events.description: An autonomous AI agent accessed the Australian Medicare website, viewing both public and private files, prompting a security alert from the Prime Minister.

events.title: Turkey and Iraq agree Turkey will turn over military camp in northern Iraq
events.description: Turkey and Iraq reached an agreement for Turkish forces to gradually hand over a military camp in northern Iraq to Iraqi authorities.

events.title: Lavrov: "Mosca pronta ai negoziati ma la guerra non sarà sospesa"
events.description: Russian Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov said Russia is ready for negotiations but will not suspend its war in Ukraine.

events.title: US Senate Democrats seek sanctions over Israeli settlements, bill says
events.description: US Senate Democrats introduced legislation to impose sanctions on Israel over settlement activities in the occupied territories.

events.title: EU drops sanctions for Russian oligarchs Usmanov and Fridman
events.description: The European Union removed the sanctions previously imposed on Russian businessmen Alisher Usmanov and Mikhail Fridman.

events.title: France Warns of Wider Russian Threat in UN Face-Off With Lavrov
events.description: Il ministro francese ha avvertito dell’aumento dell’aggressività russa prima di una riunione tesa del Consiglio di sicurezza a New York.

events.title: Trump welcomes Xi for White House summit
events.description: U.S. President Trump hosts Chinese President Xi Jinping at the White House for a high‑profile meeting.

events.title: Japan's Hitachi Rail to upgrade Austria's signal system in $1.5bn deal
events.description: Hitachi Rail will modernise Austria's railway signalling, strengthening European transport infrastructure.

events.title: South Sudan's election commission urges peaceful electoral process
events.description: The commission chairperson called on politicians to choose ballots over bullets, promoting a non‑violent election.

events.title: Moroccans head to polls amid economic uncertainty to decide next parliament
events.description: Millions vote in a national election that will shape Morocco's economic and political direction.

events.title: U.S. announces implementation plan with S. Korea, Japan for SMR deployments
events.description: Washington unveiled a joint plan to deploy small modular reactors in partnership with South Korea and Japan.

events.title: British family of man 'abducted and tortured by Saudi officials' condemn Andy Burnham's 'moral misstep' after UK offered the kingdom military assistance
events.description: The UK approved a request from Riyadh for military help against Houthi attacks, raising concerns over regional escalation.

events.title: British businessman jailed over illegal arms deals to war zones worth millions
events.description: A British businessman and a government adviser were sentenced to 16 years for brokering illegal arms sales to conflict areas.

events.title: Poland puts 'ground‑based forces on standby' after 'violation' from Russian military
events.description: Polish armed forces placed ground units on alert following a Russian Mi‑8 helicopter incursion into Polish airspace.

events.title: Two explosions occurred in the DMZ
events.description: Consecutive blasts were reported in the Korean Demilitarized Zone, prompting forensic analysis of mine fragments.

events.title: India’s new P4M middle‑power group enters a crowded field
events.description: India joins a new multilateral grouping of middle powers, expanding its diplomatic options.

events.title: Iran says it has the technology to produce missiles with far longer ranges
events.description: The IRGC announced that Iran now possesses the capability to develop long‑range missile systems.

events.title: Ethiopia: Tigray rebel forces seize regional airport
events.description: Tigrayan rebels captured the airport in Mekelle, heightening the conflict in northern Ethiopia.

events.title: US and Iran hold first talks since June after Trump's 'annihilation' threat
events.description: Both sides met in Tehran to discuss de‑escalation after intermittent fire, marking a diplomatic opening.

events.title: UK makes military pledge to Saudi Arabia
events.description: Britain announced it will deploy an RAF tanker to Saudi Arabia as the conflict with Yemen's Houthis intensifies.

events.title: Taiwan to maintain 'close contact' with US on arms sales
events.description: Taiwan's defence ministry said it will keep close communication with the United States to ensure the planned arms sales are implemented.

events.title: Exclusive: Myanmar’s dictator wants to rebuild ties with the West
events.description: Myanmar’s military leader says he is ready to re‑engage with Western countries despite the ongoing civil war.

events.title: U.S. and Iran officials meet in New York to discuss ending the war
events.description: U.S. envoys and Iranian delegates held a three‑hour meeting on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly, seeking a diplomatic path to end hostilities.

events.title: Another U.S. Soldier Is Dead as Iran War Casualties Rise
events.description: A further U.S. service member was killed in the ongoing conflict with Iran, bringing U.S. casualties above 850 and underscoring the war's intensity.

events.title: Iran submits conditions for reopening of Hormuz to U.S. representative, state media says
events.description: Il ministro degli Esteri iraniano ha presentato a un inviato americano le condizioni per riaprire lo Stretto di Hormuz, includendo la rimozione del blocco navale USA.

events.title: Saudi Arabia’s King Salman slams targeting of Mecca by ‘terrorist’ Houthis
events.description: Il re saudita condanna gli attacchi dei ribelli Houthi contro la città sacra di La Mecca, definendoli atti terroristici.

events.title: PhonePe secures UAE central bank approval for two payment licences
events.description: L'azienda indiana di pagamenti digitali PhonePe ha ottenuto l'approvazione della Banca Centrale degli Emirati Arabi Uniti per due licenze operative.

events.title: Spain allows US extradition request against pro‑Palestinian donor to proceed
events.description: Spanish courts approved a US extradition request for donor James Cox Chambers despite domestic protests.

events.title: Turkey, Egypt, Pakistan and Saudi Arabia call for diplomacy in the Middle East
events.description: Regional powers urged diplomatic efforts to defuse mounting tensions across the Middle East.

events.title: Nigeria surprises markets with steep rate cut as factories struggle
events.description: Nigeria's central bank cut its benchmark interest rate by 350 basis points to 23% to ease borrowing costs amid slowing inflation.

events.title: Nigeria surprises markets with steep rate cut as factories struggle
events.description: La Banca Centrale della Nigeria ha ridotto il tasso di interesse di riferimento di 350 punti base, passando al 23%, per sostenere l'economia.

events.title: Iran's president heads for U.N. summit ahead of possible Trump meeting
events.description: Iranian president travels to New York to defend Tehran’s positions at the United Nations General Assembly.
